notes: Profiles read best. Knees are limited to 25 deg, so the crouch drop is only what the legs give at the limit. Front/back: knees-out crouch and arms in-plane (a forward swing is out of plane there).

hairFold.source: hair/actions/hair_actions.json clips.jump BodyLean (keys for apose/tpose/back, viewKeys for left/right)
hairFold.rule: BodyLean = clamp(body + hair, -1, 1), sampled at 30 fps

stressNote: RENDER-ONLY STRESS TEST: WANTED (unclamped) angles in rig units, values beyond +-1.0 are intentional (e.g. knee 80 deg = 3.2), and RootY is the unclamped pendingRoot (beyond the v1.8 +-40 px). Exceeds the rig limits; the renderer clamps params to their range, so render with clamping bypassed. Never ship or play as a clip. Same beats as body_tools/actions/jump.json (the clamped, shippable version).
format: shadowveil body action clip v1 (stress variant)
units: limbs x25 deg, BodyLean x8 deg, Toe -1 = 30 deg up; RootY px (+down), unclamped
